tips: A GPU is a very expensive space heater that also does math.
"Alignment" means getting the computer to want what you want. Try it on a cat first.
Every training run starts with "this one will be different."
Vibes cannot be measured, but they can be graphed! Look up and to the left at the big gold star.
Tokens are tiny pieces of words. Investors are tiny pieces of everything.
A benchmark is a test the computer takes. The computer has seen the test. Shh.
The cloud is just somebody else's computer. A very loud one, in a very large shed.
Hype goes UP when you say "agents." Hype goes DOWN when somebody asks what they do.
Kombucha has billions of live cultures. Your lab has about nine live interns.
"Emergent abilities" are things nobody planned and everybody puts on a slide.
The scaling laws say: more compute, more better. The finance department says: no.
Green means go, red means stop, and the big red button means: ask a grown-up.
Fine-tuning is teaching a model to be polite. Some models learn faster than interns.
Runway is how many months until the money runs out. It is measured in months and feelings.
